mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% in the month prior to the decision date reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS > 5.25% for the next 60 days, or discount rate sensitivity (Rank IC) is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 50,000 jobs in the prior month coincides with stronger consumer confidence and drives upward momentum in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) over 60 days after the trigger, or lagged confidence indices (e.g., CPIAUCSL) show no correlation with the return signal.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls by more than 2% in two consecutive months, it indicates weakening manufacturing momentum that precedes a short-term decline in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO declines meeting the trigger, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 202 in the month before the decision suggests underpricing pressures that boost short-term S&P 500 optimism over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative when CPIAUCSL meets the trigger, or the effect is spurious (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising unemployment rates (UNRATE) above 4.5% indicate a tightening labor market that, when combined with elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 205), produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Return is positive despite both triggers being met, or interaction term (IC) is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (not available in the provided catalog) is proxy by a 30-day moving average of HOUST falling by 3% or more, signaling softening demand that precedes S&P 500 drawdowns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive despite the trigger, or the effect is not robust across multiple macro regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly retail sales (not available) are replaced by a proxy: a 2-month moving average of GDPC1 exceeds 12% growth, it reflects strong consumer demand that is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant return (p > 0.1) in the 20 days after the trigger, or the signal is spurious (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of extreme volatility in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 6% or < 3.5%), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days are uncorrelated with traditional economic indicators and exhibit regime-dependent randomness.
failure_condition: The regime is misidentified (e.g., FEDFUNDS not in the stated range), or 5-day returns show a consistent directional bias contrary to the regime expectation.
